minimum_requirements: Literal executable/argv arrays; no assembled shell strings; preserve native output and final exit.
Admit before setup, config execution, plugin loading, collection, or tests.
Use native pytest config parsing, including pytest9 TOML; serial must not require xdist.
Validate parsed pytest settings and pinned critical hooks; reject xdist remote/proxy transports before creation.
Vitest3 one-project standard forks only initially; normalize pool min/max and worker environment, then validate same instance.
Preserve configured terminal reporters and coverage gates; append Vitest evidence reporter through configureVitest config hook.
Explicit source-to-test groups plus exact native inventory; unknown influence widens to full.
Retain exact test identities where available and unresolved file/full-gate obligations where identity is uncertain.
Declare npm shell/lifecycle and uv setup semantics; do not silently replace or bypass user commands.
Bound Go/Cargo native controls only in a proved profile; disclose arbitrary subprocess residuals.
Unsupported versions, control hooks, pools, launchers or harnesses never inherit first-class claims.
limitations: Hook ordering, reporter injection, worker bootstrap, coverage/exit parity and cancellation remain untested proposals.
Exact pins are acceptance candidates, not an already-tested support range.
Vitest 3.2.7 release notes and creation/plugin source were inspected; installed runner source was 3.2.6.
Critical-hook allowlists and native worker controls are compatibility restrictions, not a sandbox.
No source changes, installations, tests, provider calls, main merge, push, or deployment.
